name: job-finder
description: Set up job-finder for a new person from Cowork (job-finder-setup), then run the whole weekly cycle with no API key: poll the boards, read the new job descriptions in-session, write the digest, and tailor, fact-check, render and fill the top roles, stopping before submit (job-finder-weekly). Bump the version on every change that must reach Cowork; the version shown in Cowork's plugin list is the only way to see whether the installed snapshot matches the repo.
